title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 stale-bounce gate compares RFC3339 'at' against Postgres corrected_at::text — same-day redelivered pre-correction bounces still exhaust the corrected row
detail: Attempts 'at' is RFC3339 ('T' at char 10) while corrected_at::text uses a space; same-calendar-date pairs always compare at > corrected, so a same-day redelivered pre-correction bounce is treated as genuine, exhausts the corrected row, and stamps referee_contact_invalid on a contact never re-tried — the gate only stands down cross-date.
recommended_fix: Compare instants, not strings: emit matched_send_at and corrected_at in one canonical format (or epoch) from find_reference_call_by_send_ref before the string.compare gate.
